extracted.name: Peanut Butter Marshmallow Squares
extracted.description: This no-bake peanut butter marshmallow square recipe features butterscotch chips, coconut, and walnuts for a sweet treat the whole family will enjoy.
instruction_lines: Place butterscotch chips, peanut butter, and butter in the top of a double boiler over simmering water. Stir frequently, scraping down the sides with a rubber spatula to avoid scorching, until melted and combined, about 5 minutes.
Stir marshmallows, coconut, and walnuts into butterscotch mixture until evenly combined.
Pour mixture into prepared pan. Refrigerate until set, about 1 hour. Cut into 18 squares and store in the refrigerator.
